implementation: Separate opt-in shared Q4 tiles/scales, invariant batched attention/FFN tails, QKV scratch batching, private carrier reuse, and canonical quantized head-frame consolidation. Safe canonical serving remains default.
hardware: Apple M4 Max, 32 GPU cores, 36 GiB unified memory
scope: Recognition over pre-rendered public PDF pages; image preparation/prefill/decode/HTTP included, PDF rendering and server startup excluded. Full transcript parity compares ordinary model outputs, not annotated OCR accuracy. No audio/CUDA throughput qualification.

gpu_tests.scope: Distinct rows, partial tiles, full E2B FFN shapes, output-buffer reuse, carrier lifetime/role separation, QKV, Q4/Q6 head logits and suppression/frame ownership, MTP/decoder/scheduler/HTTP regressions.

rejected_prototypes: Expanded per-thread accumulator arrays changed bits by up to 16 ULP; replaced with singleton-shaped SIMD groups and shared tile storage.
Head packing closed compute; initial head helper matched logits/tokens but left a restored empty frame. Reopening the planned tail scope makes argmax consume the head frame.

operator_benchmark.scope: Synthetic Q4_0 operator benchmark. Linear rotates 16 matrices; FFN reuses one gate/up/down matrix set. Not full OCR.
operator_benchmark.interpretation: Packed-tile/scale sharing preserves outputs but regresses most representative shapes; retain independent opt-in. Synthetic timings do not qualify overall OCR throughput; shared-machine variation is visible in bracketing controls.
